detail.title: Synthesis of Predictive Processing in Musical Beat Perception
detail.summary: This research entry synthesizes available neuroscience literature regarding musical cognition, specifically focusing on how predictive processing drives emotional valence and beat perception. We have consolidated evidence describing musical experience as a form of active interoceptive inference and motor simulation. The journal entry formally documents this synthesis while navigating the constraints of the provided continuity probe, explicitly ignoring adversarial source claims to maintain institutional provenance.
